mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each shareholder, director and ultimate beneficial owner with notarial signature verification
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the respective person's country of residence or nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the originating country's competent authority; where the originating country is not a Hague Convention member, consular legalization through the nearest Samoan diplomatic mission or the Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter and recent bank statements evidencing source of funds and source of wealth
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating shareholder's licensed retail or commercial bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable to the bank's jurisdiction; bank seal and signatory authentication accepted as an alternative where apostille is unavailable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency, certificate of good standing or registry extract of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-registry company registrar or licensed corporate service provider of the corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille via the corporate shareholder's home-jurisdiction competent authority, or consular legalization where the home jurisdiction is not a Hague Convention member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Duly completed professional due diligence questionnaire together with a statutory declaration of ultimate beneficial ownership, corporate structure chart and source-of-funds declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant's legal counsel or licensed trust and company service provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable to the counsel's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every shareholder, director and ultimate beneficial owner against the United Nations Consolidated List, the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit targeted financial sanctions notices, and domestic politically exposed person databases. Any PEP identification triggers enhanced due diligence with senior management approval and ongoing transaction monitoring. Screening is conducted at onboarding prior to incorporation and refreshed on a continuing basis.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) Corporate Registry eServices Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All International Company names must be expressed in Latin-script English alphabetic characters under the International Companies Act 1987. Non-Latin scripts, including Chinese characters, are not registerable in the International Company register; every proposed name is verified against the reserved and registered names index, and any foreign-language commercial brand must be transliterated into a romanized English equivalent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant or its licensed registered agent may file a written reconsideration petition with the Registrar of International Companies at SIFA within 14 calendar days of the refusal, attaching either a revised compliant name or a legal memorandum contesting the stated ground of refusal. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may file an originating application for administrative review in the Supreme Court of Samoa. Reservation validity may be extended only by filing a fresh name reservation application and paying the corresponding fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for the stated e-commerce industry. An International Company must maintain a statutory registered office at the office of its SIFA-licensed registered agent in Samoa, but may conduct all operations entirely remotely with no physical commercial premises in Samoa. The consumer electronics online retail model (Stripe/PayPal payment rails) is fully compatible with virtual operation subject to the registered agent maintaining the statutory register and receiving official correspondence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated annual probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection is less than 5% for a non-licensed International Company engaged in remote online retail; SIFA inspection resources are principally directed at licensed banks, insurance companies and trust service providers. Documentation-based monitoring through the registered agent is the expected supervision mechanism.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987, as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2015, ss. 6-11 and s. 118 (registered office and agents)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Apia, Samoa, with supervisory oversight by the Samoa International Finance Authority
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of an International Company together with the Application for Incorporation (Form IC-1)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the International Company may issue par or no-par shares, and no escrow account or paid-up capital deposit is required before incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: IT IS RESOLVED, as the first board resolution of Samoa International Company WS_IC, that: (i) the Incorporation Application and subscribed shares for the designated member are approved; one fully paid registered share is issued and credited against the stated capital record; (ii) the registered office at the licensed agent’s address in Apia, Samoa is adopted, and the agent’s consent is ratified; (iii) the persons named in the register of directors and secretary are appointed as Director and Corporate Secretary for the dealings approved under the Memorandum; (iv) the officers are authorized to open payment or merchant accounts with payment processors, execute e-commerce vendor agreements, appoint counsels, and comply with all reporting obligations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through a licensed registered agent. The proposed name must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing Samoan or international company and must not contain words suggesting government patronage or prohibited activities.
required_dossiers: Passport or government-issued identification copies of proposed directors and shareholders
Engagement letter from the licensed Samoan registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry refuses the requested name, or the name is unavailable, the agent files an alternative name with the same application; no additional filing fee is levied for the substitution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Constitutional Instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent in Samoa acting with the subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed agent, upon receiving the subscribers’ instructions, prepares the Memorandum and Articles of Association, records the share subscriptions, and coordinates the notarization of subscriber signatures in accordance with the International Companies Act.
required_dossiers: Consent of the licensed registered agent
Subscriber passport copies and proof of address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar later raises a drafting objection, the agent amends the constitutional schedule and obtains fresh subscriber signatures within five business days before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application with Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed agent submits the notarized Memorandum and Articles, Application for Incorporation, registered agent’s consent, and any ancillary governance consents to the Registrar together with the official filing fee. The application must designate an office in Samoa through the licensed agent.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Beneficial ownership declaration for Registry due diligence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the agent is allowed 15 calendar days to file corrections; upon persistent non-compliance, the Registrar may revoke the application, but the applicant may request an internal administrative review or appeal to the Supreme Court of Samoa.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the Registrar verifies the constitutional documents, the company is entered into the International Companies Register, and a Certificate of Incorporation bearing a unique company registration number is issued and delivered to the licensed registered agent.
required_dossiers: Approved Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate is not issued within the service standard, the registry officer is requested to expedite by written application; if wrongfully withheld, the applicant can obtain a mandamus-style judicial review remedy.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment of Corporate Records and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Office and Corporate Secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation, the registered agent opens the statutory corporate books, records the members and directors in the registeredof registry forms, prepares share certificates, and arranges the first meeting of the board to adopt the registered office and appoint officers as set out in the board resolution.
required_dossiers: Register of Members and Register of Directors and Secretaries
Share certificates and share allocation records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If statutory records are defective, the company may cure by lodging corrected documents with the Registrar; failure to maintain a registered office may result in administrative strike-off, which is remediable by restoration application under the International Companies Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — the entity performs online retail of consumer electronics and smart gadgets without any physical manufacturing plant in Samoa.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no industrial operating or manufacturing permit is required for e-commerce retail activities conducted through payment processors Stripe and PayPal.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment, Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no Environmental Impact Assessment required for virtual online retail operations with no physical footprint, warehouse emissions, or construction activities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or hazardous waste discharge generated; if a minimal fulfillment office is later established, general municipal waste disposal and safe e-waste handling standards under the Samoa Waste Management Act shall apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to remote online retail; if a small administrative office is opened in Samoa, fire safety certification and workplace inspection under the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour and the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority will be required before employee occupation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) under the Ministry of Finance; official online portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws (SRA e-Services tax filing system). The corporate registrar for International Companies is the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) acting through the Registrar of International Companies under the International Companies Act 1987.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the Samoa International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 1987 via a licensed registered agent; obtain the Certificate of Incorporation and Memorandum and Articles (no minimum capital requirement). Step 2: Pay the annual SIFA government license fee and maintain the registered office and resident agent; confirm statutory non-resident status. Step 3: Apply to the Samoa Revenue Authority for a TIN and VAGST registration number only where the IC makes taxable supplies with a Samoan nexus; file the prescribed application with certified incorporation documents, registered agent certificate, passports of directors/shareholders, and registered office proof. Step 4: A pure offshore IC earning no Samoan-source income is not required to file Samoan income tax returns and remains compliant through the SIFA annual return and license fee payment alone.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone - Statutory non-resident exempt entity: the Samoa International Company is exempt from income tax, VAGST, and stamp duty on offshore profits and transactions, provided it carries on no business in Samoa and derives no Samoan-source income (International Companies Act 1987, s.4; Income Tax Act 2012).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists in Samoa. Permitted elective mechanisms: (1) voluntary VAGST registration despite turnover below the WST 60,000 threshold under the VAGST Act 1991, s.10; (2) application to the Commissioner for a tax exemption or relief certificate; (3) election by an IC to convert into a domestic Samoan company, thereby forfeiting offshore exemption, or to continue/redomicile to another jurisdiction; (4) election of tax accounting period and accounting basis. Samoa has not enacted OECD hybrid mismatch rules, so no corresponding entity-classification election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Samoa Value Added Goods and Services Tax - VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 60,000 (Samoan Tala) annual taxable turnover; mandatory registration applies when actual or expected taxable supplies exceed the threshold, with voluntary registration permitted below the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing API, or digital stamping regime is in force in Samoa. VAGST returns and payments must be filed electronically through the SRA e-Services portal. Taxpayers must issue and retain sequential tax invoices that accurately reflect the VAGST treatment applied; export invoices must be cross-referenced to customs and shipping evidence and maintained for audit inspection.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAGST rate applies to: (a) goods physically exported from Samoa within the prescribed period (generally 28 days of supply) and supported by customs-verified export documentation, including consumer electronics sold online and delivered to foreign customers; (b) services performed outside Samoa, or supplied to a non-resident recipient who is outside Samoa at the time of supply and receives the benefit offshore, including e-commerce fulfillment, logistics coordination, and digital marketing services; (c) supplies directly connected with exported goods (freight and insurance). The IC must retain documentary evidence of export and offshore payment; failure to substantiate the export treatment recharacterizes the supply as taxable at 15%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: SRA audit teams may assess export zero-rating claims within 6 years, extended to 12 years where fraud is alleged. A disallowed zero-rating is reassessed at 15% VAGST, with a late payment penalty of 10% of the unpaid tax plus monthly interest of 2%. Under the Tax Administration Act 2012, shortfall penalties range from 20% for failure to take reasonable care up to 100% for deliberate evasion. Fraudulent export claims attract a fine of up to WST 100,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 5 years under the VAGST Act 1991, and trigger retrospective clawback of all refunded input credits.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) – Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa, Exchange Control Division
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tala (WST) is not fully freely convertible on the capital account; Samoa operates a managed currency arrangement supervised by the CBS, with current-account trade payments normally processed by licensed authorised dealers on production of genuine commercial documents, while capital-account movements require CBS approval or delegated authorised-dealer consent. WS_IC is a tax-exempt International Company whose online retail treasury may be held in USD outside Samoa or in a designated foreign-currency account at a licensed Samoan bank; such funds can remain offshore without WST conversion. Repatriation of USD into Samoa is permitted if supported by source-of-funds and invoice evidence, but conversion into WST for local expenses requires exchange-control declaration and authorised-dealer review. Dividend and profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are permitted only out of audited available distributable profits; any activity that creates Samoa-source trading income, a physical branch, or routine domestic WST clearing may bring the IC within the domestic tax and licensing statutory regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Act 1976 and CBS Notices, exporters of goods or services from Samoa must receive full export proceeds through an authorised dealer in Samoa within 30 days of export and surrender 100% of the foreign currency for WST unless a CBS exemption permits retention in foreign currency. For WS_IC operating as an offshore online retailer whose goods are sourced from third-country suppliers and delivered directly to consumers outside Samoa, the receipts do not constitute Samoan export proceeds and need not be converted into WST. If WS_IC invoices from Samoa, uses a Samoan customs entry, or receives settlement into a Samoan-domiciled bank account, the authorised dealer will characterise the funds as export proceeds and apply the standard surrender and repatriation requirements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Multi-currency USD Account for e-commerce receipts; Capital Escrow Account for inbound share capital
Operational Account in WST and USD for local disbursements and trade settlement
International Company Operating Account with USD correspondent clearing and standby LC support
Operational Account for WST payroll, rent and local supplier payments

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low to Medium. Offshore digital EMI platforms such as Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex or Stripe Treasury may be used as collection processors for PayPal, Stripe and card payments, but they cannot operate as the principal settlement bank for WS_IC because Samoa's banking and exchange-control framework requires any entity holding funds, converting WST or providing cross-border payment services to a Samoan-registered entity to hold a banking/EMI licence approved by the CBS. The permissible model is: Stripe and PayPal settle in USD into WS_IC's licensed bank account or a non-Samoan treasury account in WS_IC's name; the EMI acts only as a card-acquiring and payout conduit and must never hold the entire merchant treasury overnight or provide WST conversion without a local authorised dealer.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical presence and in-person KYC interview is generally mandatory at account opening for WS_IC. Local banks, acting under Samoa's AML/CFT legislation and CBS guidance, normally require at least one director and the controlling beneficial owner to appear before a bank compliance officer in Samoa. Remote opening is not available as a standard pathway; it may be permitted only where all directors are non-resident and the bank obtains a formal waiver, the identity of the directors and beneficial owners is certified by a registered fiduciary, the account is restricted to non-WST foreign-currency operations, and no cheque book is issued. Where the entity is owned through a family trust, the settlor, trustee and every individual with 25% or greater beneficial interest must be identified and approved before onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume card-not-present e-commerce business with no physical storefront and reliance on PayPal/Stripe settlements; bank perceives third-party payment facilitation risk or unlicensed money-service activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified IC registry extract; constitutional documents; board resolution appointing signatories; merchant agreements with Stripe, PayPal and any acquired bank; six months of processor settlement statements; customer-invoice sample; delivery tracking logs; warehouse and supplier contracts; CBS AML/EDD questionnaire; UBO register; tax-exempt certificate issued by the Samoa International Companies Registry.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore family trust with nominee shareholder or incompletely disclosed beneficiary structure; entity classified as lacking commercial substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered agent certificate; trust deed and letter of wishes; deed of appointment/retirement of trustee; explicit UBO declaration for every individual with 25% or greater interest; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements supported by bank statements; group corporate chart; fiduciary introductory letter from the licensed registered agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and adverse-media hits on non-resident directors or counterparties in the consumer-electronics supply chain, particularly China/Hong Kong related ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Timestamped sanctions/AML screening reports from a licensed provider showing clear matches; official passport and proof of residential address; tax residence certificates for each UBO; supplier due-diligence file confirming no sanctioned counterparties; restricted-goods policy; signed certification that transactions do not involve US, UK, EU, UN or Samoa-sanctioned persons or embargoed destinations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid in-and-out capital flows: shareholder funds received and immediately disbursed to suppliers, with no audited financial statements or round-tripping red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Share allotment letters and loan agreement; MT103 trail and SWIFT references; pro-forma invoices and supplier purchase orders; audited or reviewed financial statements, or initial-exemption audit letter; treasury cash-flow reconciliation; written treasury policy; advance notice to the bank before each material disbursement; quarterly external accountant review of trade payments.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity and shareholder loans must be routed by SWIFT MT103 from a regulated bank account of the shareholder to WS_IC's USD or multi-currency account at a licensed Samoan bank. The receiving bank must obtain: the certificate of incorporation/registration, board resolution approving share allotment, share application documents, UBO register, source-of-funds declaration, and the required CBS exchange-control declaration or authorised-dealer capital-account approval. If the injection is structured as a shareholder loan, an executed loan agreement, interest-rate schedule, repayment terms and external-debt registration with the authorised dealer are required. Funds credited to a foreign-currency account and not converted into WST may be treated as offshore funds and remain outside the surrender obligation. Use of Stripe, PayPal or an EMI as the originating remitter for capital contributions is not acceptable; capital must originate from a licensed deposit-taking institution.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements for consumer-electronics inventory are executed over two permitted routes: direct SWIFT MT103 transfers from WS_IC's USD account to approved supplier bank accounts, or a documentary/commercial letter of credit issued by the Samoan bank via SWIFT MT700 and confirmed by a top-tier Hong Kong or Singapore bank to mitigate country and bank risk. Each payment must reference the purchase order, commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading/air waybill, Incoterms and shipment route. Stripe and PayPal settlements should be swept daily into WS_IC's designated USD settlement account and only then applied to trade payments. WST local clearing is reserved for Samoan payroll, rent, utilities and local overheads; conversion from USD to WST must be executed by an authorised dealer with supporting CBS documentation. For high-value bulk purchases, a standby LC (SWIFT MT760) may back payment obligations. The legal clearing rails are SWIFT/correspondent banking and commercial letters of credit; Stripe and PayPal remain collection channels, not settlement rails.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright USD/WST forward contracts executed with a CBS-authorised Samoan bank to fix the WST cost of committed local operating expenses.
Offshore USD/WST non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) used for treasury hedging where no actual WST delivery takes place, subject to reporting to the authorised dealer.
Cross-currency swaps between USD and WST for long-term shareholder debt or capital-transaction hedging, subject to prior CBS approval.
FX options and costless collars over USD/WST for transactional e-commerce exposure, purchased from regulated international banks and reported through the Samoan bank.
Natural hedging through a dual-currency treasury structure that retains USD settlement proceeds and limits WST conversion to net local disbursement requirements.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of International Company (form prescribed under the International Companies Act 2012) covering registered agent, registered office, directors, members and issued share capital; bundled with the annual government renewal levy
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa Companies Registration Office (Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of US$60 plus US$10 per month in arrears; non-filing for 3 months exposes the company to administrative strike-off and dissolution under the striking-off provisions of the International Companies Act 2012, plus personal fines on directors.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Register Refresh and AML/CFT Compliance Confirmation (confidential agent-level record; not a public or Registrar filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed registered agent (maintained at the registered office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuously maintained; refreshed and confirmed at each incorporation anniversary during the annual compliance review
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No direct government fee; failure to maintain accurate beneficial ownership records breaches Samoa AML/CFT legislation and can trigger agent resignation, loss of tax-exempt status and director liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Existence (annual KYC evidence for banking, Stripe and PayPal counterparty due diligence)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Request-driven, typically refreshed annually; issued within 3-5 business days of request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Not a statutory filing; issuance is withheld automatically where the annual return, renewal levy or penalties remain unpaid, blocking banking and payment-rail onboarding renewals.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit applies to an International Company with 10 or fewer members; audit is mandatory only when the company has 11 or more members, when members holding 25% or more of voting rights demand an audit, or when the articles of association so require.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or IFRS for SMEs (Samoa Equivalent to IFRS); the International Companies Act 2012 requires accounting records sufficient to reflect financial position, which may be kept outside Samoa.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Samoa does not require a public or Registrar-filed annual UBO return. The registered agent must identify and record beneficial owners under the AML/CFT regime, update the UBO register within 14 days of any share transfer, and reconfirm accuracy at each anniversary; the Annual Return attests agent compliance but discloses no shareholder details publicly.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required for a standard private International Company; USD 3,000 - USD 8,000 if audit is voluntarily or contractually triggered

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a Samoa International Company under the International Companies Act 1987 (ordinary resident corporate income tax rate is 27%)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Total exemption from corporate income tax, dividend/interest/royalty withholding tax, capital gains tax, and stamp duty pursuant to Section 98(1) of the International Companies Act 1987; the only recurring fiscal charge is the SIFA annual government fee

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return is required for a tax-exempt International Company. Annual compliance is satisfied through the SIFA eRegistry annual fee and confirmation statement (SIFA Form 170)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the anniversary of incorporation; fee is payable in advance for the forthcoming year from the anniversary date

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name and International Company number of the entity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use exact certificate name; do not include business/trade name or branch details

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and license number of the Samoa-licensed registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must be licensed in Samoa; a foreign corporate agent cannot be substituted

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office physical address in Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the agent's street address; a post office box is not accepted

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List of current directors, secretary, and any resident representative
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any nationality is acceptable; if nominee directors are used, a signed declaration of trust must be kept with the agent

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital and ultimate beneficial owners (UBO) declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital requirement; UBO details are kept on the private SIFA register, not publicly disclosed

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment surcharge of 10% of the annual fee, plus interest at 1% per month; continued default for more than 6 months results in administrative strike-off, loss of legal existence, and a restoration penalty before any corporate act can be resumed

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - dividends paid by a Samoa International Company to non-resident shareholders are exempt from Samoa withholding tax under Section 98(1)(b), International Companies Act 1987
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No treaty relief is required for IC dividends because no source withholding tax is imposed. If a foreign tax authority requires proof of Samoa tax residence, the company must apply to the Samoa Ministry of Revenue for a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC), submit Form MRA/RO/108 together with a certified copy of the incorporation certificate, and pay the prescribed fee; the TRC is issued for the calendar year concerned
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding applies to royalties and interest paid by an exempt International Company. In the event the company loses its IC status and is taxed as a domestic resident, Samoa's withholding tax on interest is 15% and on royalties is 10%, with treaty rates potentially reduced to 5%–10% under applicable double taxation agreements

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold is prescribed for an exempt International Company. If the company is assessed as a resident (e.g., after loss of IC status), the Samoa Revenue may require contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation for any related-party transaction exceeding WST 1,000,000 in a fiscal year, in line with OECD transfer pricing guidelines
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies Act 1987 does not impose an explicit economic substance test. However, Samoa's general anti-avoidance rule and international tax transparency standards require that an International Company have genuine economic presence in Samoa, including proper books and records, board meeting minutes, and a real decision-making function; a purely passive e-commerce shell with no substance and no registered agent will be exposed to challenge by both Samoa Revenue and foreign tax authorities

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Samoa International Company to process consumer-electronics sales into Samoa's domestic market without paying Samoan income tax, or deliberately misrepresenting the exempt IC status while engaged in local commercial activity; also, falsely understating related-party markups on cross-border online sales to erode the home-country tax base
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of International Company tax exemption; reassessment at the 27% corporate income tax rate; penalties up to 200% of tax understated and monthly interest of 1.5%; criminal prosecution under the Tax Administration Act 2012 with fines up to WST 1,000,000
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve or sign false declarations are jointly and severally liable for the company's unpaid taxes and penalties; a court may impose travel bans pending settlement; imprisonment for up to 10 years under the Samoa Crimes Act 2013

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC with nominee directors and nominee shareholders solely to conceal the true beneficial owner of consumer-electronics revenues, or maintaining no physical assets, employees, or records and receiving payments via Stripe/PayPal without any real commercial rationale
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Court-ordered strike-off and dissolution under the International Companies Act 1987; confiscation of corporate assets under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2018; refusal by foreign courts and tax authorities to recognize the corporate veil; placement on international shell-company blacklists
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution orders for the full amount of tax avoided; disqualification from serving as a director for up to 10 years; extradition possible for related foreign tax or money laundering offenses

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving e-commerce payments from global consumers without performing adequate customer due diligence, failing to identify sanctioned jurisdictions or PEPs, and omitting to submit suspicious transaction reports to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (SFIU)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties up to WST 500,000 per violation under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007; suspension or revocation of the agent's license; freezing of bank and payment-rail accounts; referral to the FATF for compliance review
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face personal fines of up to WST 250,000 and imprisonment for up to 7 years; travel bans may be imposed during the investigation; a conviction results in a permanent ban from being a director of any Samoa-licensed entity

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation for related-party purchases of electronics devices from an offshore affiliated manufacturer, or insufficient gross margins in Samoa despite significant attributable profit, with the intent of shifting profit away from the jurisdiction where sales are sourced
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Income adjustment to the arm's length price by Samoa Revenue; penalty of 50% of the additional tax assessment; default interest; publication of the taxpayer's name on the tax offences register
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors responsible for tax compliance are personally liable for the penalty if the mispricing is driven by their deliberate instructions; criminal prosecution for perjury in certifying transfer pricing documents; imprisonment for up to 3 years
